# EnergyEfficiencyMetric

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A measure of computational work per unit energy consumed, specifically optimized for spike-based operations versus traditional multiply-accumulate. Quantifies the core advantage of spiking recurrent cells for iNEST, where energy constraints dominate in-network processing.
